title: AI content at scale: five checks before anything goes live
hook: AI made it cheap to produce a hundred ads. Checking them is still your job.
caption:
AI made it cheap to produce a hundred ads.
Checking them is still your job.

When making an ad costs almost nothing, the limit on a team moves from production to control. Without checks, a team launches many ads that look alike, and the ads compete with each other.

In Galvor's analysis of new video ads launched from May to September 2026, when six or more look-alikes launched within three days, each got 48% less first-month spend.

The slides have five checks to set up before the first batch of the year, and the one step most teams skip after the ads have run.

None of them needs new software. They need a rule and a name against it.

alt_text: Six-slide carousel. Five checks for AI-made ads before they go live: a reason for each ad, one change at a time, a person reading every claim, a cap on look-alike ads, and one named approver. A stat slide shows look-alike ads launched together each got 48% less first-month spend. A final step: write down what each ad taught you.
cta: Soft: save the checklist; follow Galvor

slides.headline: Making more ads is easy now. *Five checks* before any of them go live.
slides.sub: A control layer your team can set up this week.

slides.headline: less first-month spend per ad when *six or more look-alikes* launched within three days
slides.sub: Ads that look alike compete with each other.
slides.source: Source: Galvor analysis · ads launched May–Sep 2026

slides.headline: Give every ad *a reason to exist*

items.title: 1. A reason
items.detail: Each ad names the earlier ad it learns from

items.title: 2. One change
items.detail: Change the message or the look, never both at once

items.title: 3. Claims
items.detail: A person reads every product and health claim

items.title: 4. Look-alikes
items.detail: Cap how many similar ads launch in one week

items.title: 5. A name
items.detail: One person signs off and owns the result

slides.headline: Write down what each ad *taught you*
slides.body:
Two weeks after launch, log one line per ad: what we changed, what happened, what we do next.

Without that line, the next batch starts from zero, however fast it was made.

slides.headline: Set the five checks *before* the next batch
slides.sub: Save this for your first planning meeting of the year.
